description: Logging improvement for the Python e-commerce checkout service owned by the retail storefront team. The order placement module (checkout.py) calls logging.basicConfig() at import time inside library code, logs through the root logger, builds messages by string concatenation, logs errors and then re-raises the same exception (double-reporting every failure), and its messages carry no customer or order correlation IDs. Refactor its logging to production standard: module-level named logger with no configuration in the library, lazy %-style formatting, log-or-raise (never both), and customer_id/order_id/total context on checkout lifecycle events at appropriate levels. Do not change checkout behavior or exception types.
